name: Slow Tomato Confit

recipeInstructions.text: Place tomatoes in a single layer in a baking dish. Tuck garlic and thyme between them.
Pour over olive oil so tomatoes are mostly submerged. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake for 2 hours, until tomatoes are collapsed and jammy. Cool in the oil.
Store in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to a week.

description: Sweet, jammy tomatoes slow-cooked in olive oil with garlic and thyme. Great over toast or stirred through pasta.
